title: Expanded Professional/Collaborative Golden Comic Proof
objective: Prove the full SAA-01..29 family in one rights-safe, provider-off-capable end-to-end project spanning page and webtoon presentation, reusable templates, actors/poses, professional lettering, materials/finishing, drawing-layer interop, collaboration/review, multi-device recovery, multimedia/accessibility/localization, print preview, industry interchange and deterministic recovery. SAA-30 is the terminal SAA golden gate consumed by SMB10B.
acceptance: One end-to-end comic project composes the sealed SAA-01..29 capabilities without bypassing their owner-domain or rights/provenance boundaries.
The golden proof covers both ordinary page-comic and webtoon/scroll presentation while preserving one stable project/version/page/panel/layer identity graph.

Reusable templates, actor/pose projections, advanced lettering, drawing/layer interop, finishing materials/effects and reference staging compose without duplicate owner ledgers or hidden canonical mutation.
Collaboration/review and multi-device/offline recovery preserve explicit history/version lineage and fail stale or incompatible state closed.
Multimedia/accessibility/localization remain optional projections with static provider-off operation still valid and accessibility-equivalent text/reading state available.
Print/prepress and industry-interchange paths preserve rights/provenance, visible compatibility/degradation findings and no publication/distribution/upload authority.
Deterministic recovery reproduces the exact authored project state without fabricating owner truth, permissions, assets, providers or unsupported format semantics.
Completion proves SAA-01..30 completed_verified and makes the finished authoring/package contracts consumable by SMB10B and SMB-11 without rebuilding SAA authority.
boundaries: SAA-30 is proof/integration only; it does not create new Character, Scene, Dialogue, ARI, AAI, renderer, material, page/panel/layer, history, collaboration, publication or narrative authority.
Only original, user-created or rights-cleared proof content may be used; third-party rights remain enforced at use/export/interchange boundaries.
No undocumented proprietary protocol/private-format support, live AI spending, paid/cloud dependency, marketplace/public sharing, tester distribution or release/deployment is authorized.
SMB10B is a downstream consumer and is not governed-started by selecting or completing SAA-30.
next_action: Establish terminal SAA golden-proof RED across the sealed SAA-01..29 family using one rights-safe provider-off project with page/webtoon presentation, collaboration/recovery, accessibility/localization, prepress/interchange and deterministic recovery; then implement only the SAA-30 proof harness.
